hook_text: I lost a race to a snail

song.title: Slow Down
song.style: English, laid-back reggae with offbeat organ skank, deep round bass, rimshot drums and a melodica hook, warm friendly male lead vocal, slow and smiling, 110 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Always rushing, never slow
Fastest boots you'll ever know
Met a snail beside the gate
He said race you, I can't wait

[Chorus]
Slow down, slow down, take your time
Snail's ahead and I feel fine
Slow down, slow down, smell the rose
That's the way the good stuff goes

[Verse]
I stopped to watch a bumblebee
I stopped to climb the apple tree
Shared my lunch with a hungry duck
Snail went past me, just my luck

[Chorus]
Slow down, slow down, take your time
Snail has crossed the finish line
Slow down, slow down, I came last
Who knew losing was a blast

shots.prompt: {moss} power-walks down a garden path at top speed, arms pumping, glancing at a pocket watch in his hand. The camera tracks backward fast in front of him. Bright morning sun.
Green rubber boots blur along a gravel path, kicking up little stones. Low angle close-up, the camera tracks with them. Bright morning sun.
{moss} zooms past a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses who is watering her flowers, so fast that her watering can spins in her hand. The camera whip-pans as he passes. Bright morning sun.
Petals blow off a row of red tulips as something rushes past. Close-up, the camera whip-pans. Bright morning sun.

{moss} skids to a stop at a wooden garden gate and looks down at a small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell sitting on the gatepost. The camera crash zooms from him to the snail. Bright morning sun.
shots.frame: He stands at a wooden garden gate bending forward to look closely at a small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell on top of the gatepost. Medium shot. Bright morning sun.

shots.prompt: A small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell stretches up its eye stalks and stares, determined. Extreme close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, amused, pointing down at a small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell on a gatepost beside him. The camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.

A stick scratches a line across a dirt path, a small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell waiting behind it beside two green rubber boots. Low angle, the camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.
{moss} crouches at a starting line on a dirt path in a sprinter's pose beside a small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell. The camera orbits low around them. Bright morning sun.
A small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell glides forward over a line scratched in the dirt, leaving a silver trail. Extreme close-up, the camera tracks with it. Bright morning sun.
{moss} strolls along a garden path with his hands in his raincoat pockets, smiling, far behind a tiny snail up ahead. The camera cranes up over him. Bright morning sun.
A small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell looks back over its shell with one eye stalk. Close-up, the camera whip-pans to it. Bright morning sun.
{moss} buries his nose in a big pink rose on a rose bush and breathes in with his eyes closed. Close-up, the camera pushes in slowly. Bright midday sun.
shots.frame: He stands beside a rose bush leaning in with his nose touching a big pink rose, eyes closed, seen from the side. Medium shot. Bright midday sun.

shots.prompt: A big pink rose opens its petals in the sun, a red ladybird on one petal. Extreme close-up, the camera orbits it. Bright midday sun.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, blissful, holding a big pink rose, a garden in bloom behind him. The camera orbits around him. Bright midday sun.
A silver snail trail winds along a garden path into the distance. Low angle, the camera tracks along it. Bright midday sun.
{moss} crouches by a patch of lavender, nose to nose with a fat fuzzy bumblebee on a flower. The camera pushes in. Bright midday sun.
A fat fuzzy bumblebee lifts off a lavender flower and bumbles around in a lazy loop. Close-up, the camera follows it. Bright midday sun.
{moss} sits on a branch of an apple tree swinging his boots and biting into a red apple. The camera cranes up to him. Bright midday sun.

A red apple with one bite taken out of it drops into the grass beside a small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell, who glides on past it. Low angle, the camera tilts down. Bright midday sun.
{moss} sits on the bank of a pond sharing a sandwich with a white duck with an orange beak, who takes a big bite. The camera pushes in. Golden afternoon light.
A white duck with an orange beak gulps down a piece of bread and flaps happily. Close-up, the camera crash zooms in. Golden afternoon light.

A small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell glides past two green rubber boots dangling over the edge of a pond. Low angle close-up, the camera tracks with the snail. Golden afternoon light.
{moss} looks down, spots a snail overtaking him, and slaps his forehead with a laugh. The camera crash zooms in. Golden afternoon light.
shots.frame: He sits on the grassy bank of a pond looking down beside him in surprise at a small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell gliding past. Medium shot. Golden afternoon light.

shots.prompt: Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, relaxed and happy, strolling along a garden path with his hands in his raincoat pockets. The camera tracks backward in front of him. Golden afternoon light.

A grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses holds one end of a red ribbon stretched across a garden path as a finish line and waves a little green flag. The camera pushes in. Golden afternoon light.

A cream t-shirt with a hills-and-infinity-path illustration and the words Infinite Stroll hangs on a wooden fence beside a garden path, fluttering gently in the breeze, a red ribbon finish line stretched across the path below it. The camera drifts slowly toward it. Golden afternoon light.
A small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell glides through a red ribbon finish line in slow motion. Extreme close-up, the camera tracks with it. Golden afternoon light.
{moss} strolls up to a red ribbon finish line long afterwards and bows to a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses, who claps. The camera orbits around them. Golden evening light.

A small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell sits on a tiny upturned flowerpot like a winner's podium, a daisy chain around its shell. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Golden evening light.
{moss} lifts a small brown snail with a yellow racing stripe on its shell up on his open palm like a champion and laughs. The camera crash zooms in. Golden evening light.
{moss} lies in the grass at sunset with a small snail resting on the toe of his green boot, watching the sky turn pink and breathing out slowly. The camera cranes slowly up. Golden evening light.

caption: moss raced a snail and lost by hours. he stopped for a bee, an apple and a duck. the Infinite Stroll tee marked the finish
